عَجْرَفَةٌ : see عَجْرَفِيَّةٌ [which is probably syn. with it in all the senses of the former]. ―
-b2- Also Coarseness, roughness, or rudeness, in speech: and roughness, ungentleness, or awkwardness, in work. (Lth, K, TA.) ―
-b3- And Audaciousness, with هَوَج [i. e. foolishness, or tallness combined with foolishness or with foolishness and fickleness and hastiness]. (IDrd, K.) And The venturing upon, or undertaking, an affair without having knowledge in it. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
